plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: Reference for root files and the .agents directory: instructions, MCP servers, settings, keybindings, app state.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: Reference for rules/: topic-scoped instructions, optionally gated by file paths.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Reference for skills/: reusable prompts invoked by name, each a folder with SKILL.md.

plugins.name: commands
plugins.description: Reference for commands/: single-file prompts invoked with /name.

plugins.name: output-styles
plugins.description: Reference for output-styles/: custom instruction sets that adjust how the agent works.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Reference for agents/: specialized subagents with their own context window.

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Reference for workflows/: dynamic workflow scripts that orchestrate many subagents.

plugins.name: agent-memory
plugins.description: Reference for agent-memory/: persistent memory for subagents.

plugins.name: themes
plugins.description: Reference for themes/: custom color themes (global scope).

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: Reference for projects/: auto memory, per project (global scope).
